title: Manufacturing and analysis of VNbMoTaW refractory high-entropy alloy fabricated by selective laser melting
process_description: prepared by selective laser melting with pre-alloyed VNbMoTaW RHEA powder (15-53 μm particle size) on tungsten substrate preheated to 180°C, using 500W Nd:YAG fiber laser with argon shielding gas (O₂ < 200 ppm), layer thickness 30 μm, hatch spacing 90 μm, and scanning speeds of 200-800 mm/s with 67° rotation between layers
